224:t_1:3.en: ～Inside the $$マクロス・クォーター$$～

224:t_1:6.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, Big Bro... After finally meeting you again out here in the galactic center, I...」

224:t_1:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$ランカ$$. Besides... I have no right to call myself your brother.」

224:t_1:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're $$ランカ・リー$$... Your only family is your brother, $$オズマ・リー$$.」

224:t_1:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're filled with fear and anxiety now... But you should know how to break free of them.」

224:t_1:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And please remember... No matter how deep in despair you are, there are people who love you...」

224:t_1:13.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Remember that those feelings saved me when I was struggling in the darkness.」

224:t_1:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Let me hear your song again...」

224:t_1:16.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Caring about someone... saves you too...」

224:t_1:18.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...Are you feeling a little calmer, $$ランカ$$-chan?」

224:t_1:19.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シェリル$$... I keep causing you trouble.」

224:t_1:20.en:
$$シェリル$$
「It's all right. Being suddenly sent somewhere like this shocked me too.」

224:t_1:21.en:
$$シェリル$$
「But if you think about it, we've just gone back to where we started. We were actually... near the galactic center before we were sent to Earth.」

224:t_1:22.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Now that you mention it, you're right...」

224:t_1:23.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...I think it depends on how you look at things. Wherever we are, we have one thing to do.」

224:t_1:24.en:
$$ランカ$$
(What I... need to do... That's...)

224:t_1:25.en:
$$ランカ$$
(But the way I am now...)

224:t_1:30.en:
$$マックス$$
「...My daughter... $$ミレーヌ$$ has given me the general picture. First, I'd like to welcome you all.」

224:t_1:31.en:
$$マックス$$
「I'm $$マクシミリアン・ジーナス$$, commander of the 37th super long-range emigrant fleet $$マクロス７$$'s escort fleet. I also captain this $$バトル７$$.」

224:t_1:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, 55th super long-range emigrant fleet $$マクロスフロンティア$$. It's an honor to meet the legendary captain.」

224:t_1:33.en:
$$マックス$$
「A quirk of space-time has put us on the same timeline. I feel rather embarrassed to be called a legend.」

224:t_1:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You're too modest. Your exploits in the 《$$バロータ戦役$$》 are spoken of throughout the fleets.」

224:t_1:35.en:
$$オットー$$
(So that's Captain $$マックス$$, $$ミレーヌ$$'s father...)

224:t_1:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(It's amazing that he's over fifty...)

224:t_1:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
(But speaking of surprises, their chief of staff is quite a sight too.)

224:t_1:38.en:
$$オットー$$
(A $$ゼントラーディ$$ who stays in giant form all the time...)

224:t_1:39.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Then, without further delay, let me offer a theory on why you were transported to a sector so close to us.」

224:t_1:40.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「First, an introduction. I'm $$エキセドル・フォルモ$$, chief of staff of the $$マクロス７船団$$'s escort fleet.」

224:t_1:41.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As you can see, I am a $$ゼントラーディ$$.」

224:t_1:42.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I've heard of your exploits since the 《$$第一次星間大戦$$》.」

224:t_1:43.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Well... Though I've spent my life as a records officer, the world still holds many surprises for me.」

224:t_1:44.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Your recent transportation here is one of them.」

224:t_1:46.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「First, I can only describe your extraordinarily long-distance transportation from Earth to this sector in the galactic center as a mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:47.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「No one has ever artificially achieved a fold over such a distance without issues of fold faults or energy loss.」

224:t_1:48.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Yet it did happen. We should indeed call it a mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:49.en:
$$ブライト$$
「A mystery of the universe...」

224:t_1:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've certainly been caught up in something extraordinary...」

224:t_1:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Chief of Staff $$エキセドル$$... Is the $$時空震動$$ we encountered on Earth related to this transportation?」

224:t_1:52.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Though I do not know all the circumstances, that $$時空震動$$ was, so to speak, an entrance.」

224:t_1:53.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As I said earlier, why that entrance connected to the galactic center lies beyond human understanding.」

224:t_1:54.en:
$$オットー$$
「But meeting people we know like this, in such a vast universe, is an even greater miracle.」

224:t_1:55.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「However, that part was no miracle. It was caused by a certain power... a human power, at that.」

224:t_1:57.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The exit of your transportation... You returned to normal space close to us because of $$熱気バサラ$$'s power.」

224:t_1:60.en:
$$マックス$$
「Actually... At almost the same time you were transported to this sector...」

224:t_1:61.en:
$$マックス$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ was holding a tribute concert for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

224:t_1:62.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The crowd's feelings for $$熱気バサラ$$... and his singing in response... Those two things combined and brought you here.」

224:t_1:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is such a thing possible...?」

224:t_1:64.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$'s song has the power to influence even dimensions.」

224:t_1:65.en:
$$マックス$$
「Our fleet's researchers named that power $$歌エネルギー$$ and began studying it, but...」

224:t_1:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Knowing him, I can imagine he didn't like being a research subject.」

224:t_1:67.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And with him caught in a $$時空震動$$ and transported to Earth, you would have had to suspend the research.」

224:t_1:68.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Exactly. ...But during that time, we continued researching the $$プロトデビルン$$ he repelled.」

224:t_1:69.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The 《$$プロトデビルン$$》... The species that collected $$スピリチア$$, a kind of life energy, correct?」

224:t_1:70.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Correct. ...The species said to have uplifted Earth's humans in our world, the 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》...」

224:t_1:71.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「They spread across the universe, but gradually split into two factions and began fighting.」

224:t_1:72.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「They used the warrior race, the 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》, in that war.」

224:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
(So they were a kind of biological weapon...?)

224:t_1:74.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The $$プロトカルチャー$$, who created the 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》, went on to create superior beings, the 《$$エビル・シリーズ$$》.」

224:t_1:75.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Energy life-forms from another dimensional universe, the $$サブ・ユニバース$$, possessed those $$エビル$$ beings, turning them into the $$プロトデビルン$$.」

224:t_1:76.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$ needed other creatures' life energy, $$スピリチア$$, to exist. The $$プロトカルチャー$$ became their targets too...」

224:t_1:77.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「As a result, they drove the $$プロトカルチャー$$ to extinction.」

224:t_1:78.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I hear the $$プロトデビルン$$ revived after tens of thousands of years during the $$バロータ戦役$$, and $$熱気バサラ$$'s song sealed them away again.」

224:t_1:79.en:
$$マックス$$
「We feared various repercussions, so that is the publicly accepted conclusion of the $$バロータ戦役$$. But the truth is different.」

224:t_1:80.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$'s song transformed the $$プロトデビルン$$ into a species that regenerates its own $$スピリチア$$. They no longer needed it from other life-forms.」

224:t_1:82.en:
$$マックス$$
「Yes. That ended the conflict between the $$プロトデビルン$$ and humanity, and they departed for parts unknown.」

224:t_1:83.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「But many mysteries surround them, including how the energy life-forms possessed the $$エビル$$ beings. Investigating these led me to a terrifying fact.」

224:t_1:85.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The fact that the universe collapses on a 12,000-year cycle.」
